propositions: The flat _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS=100000 bound refuses contexts that fit within the resolved model's actual window, blocking valid re-certifications like c9f7 (121147 chars) at preflight

Recovery cost scales with context_chars × criteria_count, so the economic bound (3.2M chars worst case) should be expressed as a product ceiling, not conflated with the physical per-context model-window constraint

A physical ceiling derived from the model's own context window (not escalation max) and an explicit economic product ceiling must replace the single flat bound to admit realistically-sized payloads while remaining conservative

The physical ceiling should be calculated as own_window_tokens × 2 chars/token (deliberately halving admitted volume for system prompt, criteria, tools, and output) and the economic ceiling as max 3.2M chars (context × criteria product)
d59e's pinned invariants (no elision, criteria budget ≤ context budget, zero billable calls on refusal) must be preserved after moving the bound logic
